title: Display
launch_hint: Full-screen prayer times for a TV, a tablet or a computer
screen_no_times: This mosque does not publish its prayer times here yet.
unmute: Turn the adhan sound back on
sound_prompt_body: Your browser only plays sound after the screen has been touched once. Tap anywhere so the adhan can be heard at prayer time.
sound_prompt_short: Sound is off — tap to enable
choose_title: Choose your mosque to start the display
choose_body: The display shows your mosque's prayer times full screen. Find your mosque on the map and choose “Make it my mosque”.
settings_intro: The full-screen prayer times for the TV in your prayer hall. Changes appear in the preview straight away, and on the screen within a minute of saving.
personal_intro: How your own screen at /display looks and sounds. Saved to your account, on every device you use.
personal_intro_guest: How your own screen at /display looks and sounds. Saved in this browser only — sign in to keep it on every device.
simulate: Preview a moment of the prayer
section_appearance_hint: Theme, layout, colour, languages and what the screen shows.
theme_classic_hint: The familiar mosque screen, in green and gold
theme_night_sky_hint: The living sky of the day, sun and moon
orientation_hint: “Automatic” follows the shape of the screen. Choose portrait for a TV mounted on its side.
language_hint: Shown smaller under the main language. The meanings of the verses are shown in French or English.
hijri_adjust_hint: To follow the moon sighting announced in your country.
section_timing_hint: What the screen does around each prayer, from the published adhan and iqama times.
approaching_minutes_hint: The next prayer glows gently for these last minutes (0 to turn off).
adhan_minutes_hint: How long the adhan stays on screen before the countdown to the iqama.
iqama_seconds_hint: How long “Iqama” stays on screen when the prayer begins.
blackout_hint: Minutes the screen goes dark after the iqama, prayer by prayer (0 to keep it on). For Jumu'a, it covers the khutbah.
after_adhkar_hint: Shows the remembrance said after the prayer (Hisn al-Muslim) once the screen comes back.
section_rotation_hint: What the screen shows in turn beside the prayer times.
source_quran_hint: The verified Qur'an text, with the meanings from QuranEnc.
source_adhkar_hint: From Hisn al-Muslim, with their virtue and source.
source_posts_hint: Titles of the mosque's latest posts.
source_campaigns_hint: Progress of the mosque's open campaigns.
section_audio_hint: At the adhan time, the screen shows the adhan — with or without sound.
adhan_mode_sound_hint: Plays the chosen recording with the adhan screen.
adhan_mode_visual_hint: The adhan screen without sound — for a mosque with its own muezzin.
adhan_mode_off_hint: No adhan screen: the countdown to the iqama starts at the adhan time.
adhan_none: No adhan recording is available on this server yet. The adhan will be shown without sound.
muted_hint: Keeps the adhan visual but silent.
autoplay_note: Browsers only play sound after the screen has been touched once: the screen asks for one tap. On a TV in kiosk mode, sound can be allowed for good (see the tips).
section_night_hint: Dims the screen at night, outside the moments of the prayers.
section_media: Background and adhan of the mosque
section_media_hint: Your own picture behind the Classic and Arabesque themes, and your own adhan recording.
background_hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to {mb} MB. It is darkened so the times stay readable.
own_adhan_hint: An MP3 file up to {mb} MB, for example your muezzin's recording. It appears in the list of recordings.
upload_too_big: This file is larger than {mb} MB.
upload_image_unreadable: This picture could not be read. Please choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
upload_image_too_large: This picture has too many pixels (more than 40 megapixels). Please send a smaller version.
upload_audio_unreadable: This file is not an MP3 recording.
section_messages_hint: Short announcements in the rotating panel, optionally shown only between two dates.
message_placeholder: Example: Lesson after Isha on Thursday, in the main hall.
message_dates_hint: Dates and times in the mosque's time zone ({timezone}).
messages_full: The list is full: delete a message to add another.
messages_reorder_invalid: These messages could not be reordered. Please reload the page.
message_end_before_start: The end must come after the start.
section_screen_hint: Open this address on the TV of the prayer hall. Anyone can view it; only managers can change it.
tip_browser: Open the address in the TV's browser (or a small computer or stick plugged into it), then press the full-screen button that appears when you move the mouse.
tip_kiosk: On a computer, start Chrome in kiosk mode so it opens full screen and may play the adhan without a tap: chrome --kiosk --autoplay-policy=no-user-gesture-required followed by the address.
tip_chromecast: With a Chromecast or Google TV, open the address in Chrome on a computer and choose “Cast…” then “Cast tab”.
tip_firetv: On a Fire TV, install the Silk browser, open the address, add it to your favourites and switch to full screen.
tip_tablet: On a tablet, add the page to the home screen and use guided access (iPad) or screen pinning (Android) to keep it open.
tip_power: Turn off the TV's sleep timer and energy saving mode. The screen keeps itself awake, refreshes its times and keeps running if the internet drops.
